mcpBuiltinDescriptions.synon-research: Discover and call an operator-verified research capability pack through one MCP entry, without installing each source as a separate Skill.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.open-targets-official: Official Open Targets service for target and disease evidence, tractability, safety, genetics, drug mechanisms and clinical candidates.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.tamarind-bio: Cloud drug design: structure prediction, docking, protein/antibody/RNA design, molecular generation and property workflows without a local GPU.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.adaptyv-cloud-lab: Protein and antibody cloud lab: target catalog, experiment design and quotes, binding affinity, expression, thermostability and structured results.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.idc-rest: Public cancer imaging: read-only cohort discovery, metadata and guarded SQL with citation-ready evidence; no API key or local data download required.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.biomart: Ensembl BioMart — genomic annotations, identifier translation, and cross-reference queries.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.pubmed: PubMed biomedical literature — search, metadata, abstracts, full-text (PMC), related articles, ID conversion, copyright status, and citation lookup.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.clinical-trials: ClinicalTrials.gov — trial search, details, endpoints, sponsor, investigator, and eligibility queries.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.chembl: ChEMBL bioactivity database — compound, drug, and target search, bioactivities, mechanisms, and ADMET.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.biorxiv: bioRxiv/medRxiv preprints — search, metadata, published links, funder search, and usage statistics.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.variants: Human genetic variants — gnomAD frequencies and constraint, ClinVar records, dbSNP, structural, and mitochondrial variants.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.clinical-genomics: Clinical genomics knowledge — ClinGen curations and CIViC clinical evidence.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.expression: Gene expression — GTEx tissue expression and eQTLs from a pinned dataset.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.regulation: Gene regulation — ENCODE experiments, JASPAR transcription-factor matrices, and UniBind TFBS.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.protein-annotation: Protein annotation — InterPro/Pfam domains, Human Protein Atlas, and STRING interaction networks.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.rna: Non-coding RNA — Rfam families, seed alignments, covariance models, trees, and sequence regions.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.structures-interactions: Structures and molecular interactions — PDB, AlphaFold, EMDB, Complex Portal, and IntAct resources.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.omics-archives: Omics data archives — ArrayExpress/BioStudies, GEO, MGnify, and PRIDE proteomics projects.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.genes-ontologies: Gene identity and ontologies — MyGene, OLS4, GO, UniProt, and Reactome pathways.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.drug-regulatory: FDA drug data — applications, approvals, pharmacologic classes, generics, and SPL labels.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.research-resources: Research resources — Grants.gov funding opportunities and Antibody Registry lookups.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.cancer-models: Cancer genomics cohorts — cBioPortal studies, mutations, copy-number changes, and clinical attributes.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.chemistry: Small-molecule chemistry — PubChem, ChEBI, Rhea, and BindingDB searches.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.human-genetics: Human genetics associations — GWAS Catalog, eQTL Catalogue, FinnGen, and BioBank Japan PheWAS.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.literature: Scholarly literature graph — OpenAlex works, authors, venues, citations, and arXiv metadata.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.genomes: Genome annotation — Ensembl REST lookups, sequences, homology, VEP, and UCSC tracks.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.cellguide: Cell type information from CELLxGENE — descriptions, marker genes, tissues, and source datasets.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.zinc: ZINC22 purchasable chemical space — compound lookup, SMILES search, supplier resolution, and 3D docking structures.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.omtx-om: Official hosted Om MCP — LULA target-conditioned small-molecule ranking, accessible-space screening, molecule fulfillment, and generated-data access.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.patsnap-chemical-molecular: Official hosted PatSnap Chemical Molecular MCP — structure and similarity search, fragment/scaffold analysis, ADMET, patent-linked compound intelligence, and SAR extraction.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.inductive-bio: Official hosted Inductive Bio MCP — small-molecule ADMET and PK property prediction for solubility, permeability, stability, efflux, CYP, hERG, BBB, and related development risks.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.boltz-api-official: Official hosted Boltz MCP — small-molecule and protein structure/binding prediction, library screening, binder design, and ADME workflows.
mcpBuiltinDescriptions.ketcher-chemistry: Interactive 2D molecule sketcher for Ketcher MCP Apps and chemistry artifact files.
